_doc: Task 06 death causes (natural disasters). Non-graphic: they are shown as a short text, a grief buff and a grave.

tornado.label: Tornado
tornado.legacy_text: {Their} life ended in the great storm.
tornado.child_text: The storm took {them}. I'm so scared.

flood.label: Flood
flood.child_text: The water took {them}. I miss {them} so much.

earthquake.label: Earthquake
earthquake.legacy_text: {Their} life ended when the ground shook.
earthquake.child_text: The ground shook and {they} never came back.

wildfire.label: Wildfire
wildfire.legacy_text: {Their} life ended in the great fire.
wildfire.child_text: The fire took {them}. Where did {they} go?

blizzard.label: Blizzard
blizzard.child_text: It was so cold. I wish {they} had come inside.

hail.label: Hailstorm
hail.legacy_text: {Their} life ended in a freak storm.

meteor.label: Meteor
meteor.text: {name} was struck by something falling from the sky. {summary}
meteor.child_text: Something fell from the sky. It makes no sense.
